cs.t: I love mechanical keyboards (mkb) but am not obsessed about them.  Given a choice, I prefer an mkb over other keyboards.  A keyboard to my mind is a means to an end, but not an end in itself.  I do not understand people who hoard mkb's, but that's just me. In India, the best mkb you can buy is a TVS [1], and I am a happy user for many years now.  They don't market to mkb hobbyists (e.g. gamers, mkb collectors), but to heavy-duty users such as bank clerks. This kb is affordable, durable, reliable.  What more can I ask? [1]  https://www.amazon.in/gp/product/B07B75DVZS
